title: Show HN: Rowboat – Open-source, local-first alternative to Claude Desktop
summary: Rowboat is an open-source, local-first desktop application that reimagines Claude's AI assistant as a full-fledged work application rather than just a chat interface, featuring the ability to build custom work surfaces directly within the app.
problem_solved: Transforms AI chat assistants from simple conversational tools into customizable work environments with local data storage for enhanced privacy.
why_valuable: Provides developers and power users with a privacy-focused, extensible AI work environment that goes beyond traditional chat-based AI interfaces.
